items.title: Decawork
items.name: Decawork
items.summary: Control your company's internal AI agents and tools
items.description: Decawork is how IT teams take employee-built AI agents live and control every one of them from one place. An employee builds an agent on Claude Code, Codex, or any vibecoding tool; we take it in, put it on company accounts, and run it as a company asset. From there, IT team manages the agent like an employee: access, oversight, retirement.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt, I'm Sarthak - co-founder of Decawork (YC S26).

AI coding tools made it easy for anyone to build an internal agent. The hard part starts when a teammate wants to use it. Now the agent needs company credentials, access to real systems, an owner, approvals, logs, maintenance, and a way for IT to stop it.

Decawork handles that handoff. Your team still owns the job. Bring us the repo from Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or whatever your team used. Decawork operates the agent with a company identity. IT decides what it can access, reviews sensitive actions, sees what it did, and can pause or retire it from one place.

We think internal AI is unlocked by IT, not by one more agent builder. IT should not have to choose between blocking every experiment and rebuilding each one by hand.

We've spent years on both sides of this handoff. I built AI systems at NVIDIA that shipped to OpenAI and Meta, then enterprise agents for Microsoft and Hitachi. Aman (my co-founder) built Barclays' AI compliance platform, led a consumer AI product to 100K+ monthly users, and founded a fintech serving 52K families.

We'd love feedback from people building internal agents, especially the IT and security teams asked to let them touch company systems. What was the first thing that broke when your agent moved beyond its original builder?

Find a time at decawork.ai or reach out at sarthak@decawork.ai.

the retirement concept is the sleeper feature here. everyone's building agents right now, nobody's thinking about what happens when the person who built it leaves or the use case changes. having a kill switch with audit trail is going to be table stakes for any company running more than a handful of internal agents.

This is a real problem I’ve been seeing with startups - someone on the team builds agents that run on personal keys, with no audit trail and everything is all over the place with no central identity or control.
items.author: [REDACTED] / Aman
items.why: Product Hunt 当前获得 337 票、31 条评论；仍处在近期新品验证窗口；产品形态已经比较完整
items.mechanism: 可迁移的机制在于把模型从单次回答升级成持续协作代理，强调上下文记忆与多步执行。
items.routing_reason: Decawork 是一个面向 IT 团队的企业 AI agent 管理平台，专注于集中控制、权限管理和生命周期治理，而非特定业务领域的垂直应用。其核心任务属于通用基础设施，与所给兴趣点的垂直场景（法律、供应链、教育等）均不直接匹配，也不属于企业自动化工作流的具体流程自动化。因此不纳入 observation。

items.reuse_direction: 借鉴其对企业内部AI代理进行集中授权、监督与生命周期管理的思路，适用于需要治理AI工具的企业场景。

product_items.description: Jotform Data Assistant turns the data you collect into answers, insights, and action. Simply ask it to create or organize tables, analyze submissions, uncover trends, generate charts, summarize responses, or update records in bulk. Built directly into Jotform Tables and Inbox, it helps you manage your entire post-submission workflow through natural conversation, no formulas, complex filters, or repetitive manual work required.

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 研究生在读研阶段需要自主完成资料整理和汇报表达能力的提升，但导师不教，只能自己找工具和方法

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前大家在小红书以“研究生必备工具”清单互相推荐，并混入表达能力训练等标签；GitHub上已有Vermes等开源项目尝试将记忆、自学习能力打包成一体化AI Agent，覆盖这类任务。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪把“资料整理+表达训练”这类学生高频任务封装进自带记忆和自学习能力的AI Agent方向，让通用模型能力沉淀为可自托管的岗位化任务入口。

interest_sections.title: 邮件自动化工具
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、GitHub。核心观察是：外贸用户仍停留在按清单找工具，而开源社区却在为邮件自动化搭建 AI 代理协同的基础设施。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 外贸销售人员需要找到能自动辅助回复客户邮件的工具，以节省邮件处理时间

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 目前大家主要通过社交平台上的工具清单和推荐帖来获取线索，GitHub 上则已出现像 `mcp_agent_mail` 这样面向多代理邮件协调的 MCP 服务器。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得继续跟踪的方向是将邮件通信抽象成代理间的异步消息层，利用 Git 备份和 SQLite 索引实现可检索的邮件线程，为自动化工具提供稳定的数据底座。

interest_sections.title: 教育 AI 辅导
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu，核心是求职者用 AI 模拟面试官获取反馈，但免费时长和评估深度是选择关键。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 用户需要针对目标岗位进行模拟面试练习，并获得基于简历的定制问题、逐题点评和能力模型报告

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前用户通过上传简历和选择目标岗位，使用 offer goose、智面星、职得简历等工具进行 AI 模拟面试，并依赖其生成的报告和免费题库。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是免费提供深度面试评估报告并支持多种岗位场景的 AI 模拟面试产品。

interest_sections.title: AI 应用场景 / 数据
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 xiaohongshu、Product Hunt，核心观察是产品经理正从收藏工具清单转向期待数据驱动、自动产出场景洞察的 AI 工具。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 产品经理在梳理业务场景时，需要一套能快速整理需求、拆分用户流程并导出结构化文档的工具，而不是零散地手动拼凑表格和脑图

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 当前大家主要依赖小红书上的工具集测评帖互相安利，把 Jotform AI Data Assistant 这类能将表单数据自动转为洞察和行动项的产品当作场景梳理的辅助手段。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是将表单/问卷数据直接映射到用户旅程和需求优先级，并用 AI 生成可评审的场景说明和功能清单，减少人工拆解时间。
